name: TestJava

on:
  push:
     branches: ["main"]
  pull_request: ["main"]


jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
-name: Checkout repository
     uses: actions/checkout@v4

- name: Set up JDK 25
uses: actions/setup-java@v4
with:
  java-version: '25'
  distribution: 'temurin'
cache: maven

- name: Run Maven tests
run: mvn -B clean test
